name: Ramook
description: Ramook was an agriworld located just beyond the far end of the Chiloon Rift.
lead_paragraphs: Ramook was an agriworld located just beyond the far end of the Chiloon Rift.
In 45 ABY, Jedi Knight Ben Skywalker was investigating the planet for signs of Ship, a Sith Meditation Sphere controlled by Vestara Khai, a former member of the Lost Tribe of Sith.
